data.title: Ethereum Price Forecast: ETH continues to attract capital despite impending rate hike and Clarity Act failure | FXStreet
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) declined to $2,400 on Tuesday after the Clarity Act failed to progress in the Senate. Despite that and the market's near certainty of an interest rate hike at the next Federal Reserve (Fed) meeting, the top altcoin has continued to attract fresh capital.
